I replied to Pree in the thread in #central-team to confirm the new inbound lane at Marrow Agrisupply is at Dock 23. The team notes I checked in GBrain don't say anything different.

The fact isn't saved in GBrain. I tried to save it to the Central team's notes, but this connection isn't allowed to write there. The only place it would let me write is the default notes area. I didn't put it there because I can't tell who can read it, and account details like this should stay with the account's team and org-wide roles. For now, Pree's message in #central-team is the record. Saving it to the team's notes properly would need the brain host to give this connection write access there.
